summary.title: Projects
summary.description: Things I've built and run end to end outside my day job. The forecasting and recommendation work is open source, and the apps are live.

projects.title: M5 demand forecasting
projects.tagline: Hierarchical retail forecasting on Walmart's M5 dataset
projects.description: 28-day forecasts for 30,490 product-store series, comparing LightGBM with Theta and AutoETS under rolling-origin cross-validation. Includes hierarchical reconciliation (MinTrace), split conformal intervals, and a zero-shot TOTO foundation-model baseline.
projects.impact: LightGBM scores 0.642 on the official 12-level WRMSSE, roughly the top 5% of the original Kaggle leaderboard, and wins 11 of the 12 hierarchy levels.
projects.engineering: Served through FastAPI with Prometheus metrics, with Terraform for AWS, Azure, GCP, and Hetzner. 171 tests, and CI runs ruff, mypy, and a packaged-release check.
projects.alt: Animated chart of an M5 sales series with LightGBM and seasonal naive forecasts compared against held-out actuals.

projects.title: BTC market tracker
projects.description: Collects OHLCV data from Binance, Coinbase, and CoinGecko into DuckDB and serves a live Bitcoin dashboard: price tape, regime signals across liquidity, breadth, on-chain activity, volume, and ETF flows, and multi-horizon forecast bands.
projects.impact: Forecast bands are block-bootstrapped, then conformal-rescaled to 50%, 80%, and 95% coverage. The app presents them as research bands, not price targets.
projects.engineering: A private Python research toolkit: market data lands in a local DuckDB database, and Polars loads it as panels for forecasting experiments.
projects.alt: BTC market tracker dashboard showing a candlestick chart, regime readout, and liquidity, breadth, and ETF-flow indicators.

projects.title: CFB Fantasy
projects.tagline: College fantasy football platform with an LLM commissioner
projects.description: A full fantasy football platform for the Power 4 conferences and Notre Dame: live snake drafts for up to 16 teams with pick clocks, waivers, scoring, and playoffs. Draft rooms stream over server-sent events backed by Redis.
projects.impact: The AI Commish posts league commentary through an OpenAI-compatible API, with safety and schema checks, failover to Groq, and canned fallback lines if both providers are down.
projects.engineering: 1,962 tests plus Playwright end-to-end suites in CI. Built on the cfb-data warehouse.
projects.alt: Recording of a CFB Fantasy live draft room with the pick clock, available players, and draft queue.

projects.title: Sports data platform
projects.tagline: Warehouses and projection models behind four apps
projects.description: Two SQLite warehouses, nfl-data and cfb-data, that load schedules, rosters, stats, injuries, and betting lines, then score, project, and rank players for four of the apps on this page.
projects.impact: Projections run champion/challenger across LightGBM quantile, TabPFN, Bayesian, and linear models. A model is promoted only if its 80% intervals cover 75–85% of outcomes in walk-forward backtests.
projects.alt: Diagram: nflverse, Pro Football Reference, and an odds API feed the nfl-data warehouse, which serves Sleeper Brain, FFPy, and NFL Survivor. CFBD and ESPN feed cfb-data, which serves CFB Fantasy.

projects.title: arkolab
projects.description: A Typer CLI from my BASB (Building a Second Brain) repo. Its agent runs a ReAct loop with BM25 memory retrieval, a tool registry, and an audit trail on OpenRouter or local Ollama models.
projects.impact: Also runs GPU transcription with faster-whisper and an LLM-assisted pre-commit fixer. 2,075 tests across 144 test files.
projects.alt: Diagram of the arkolab agent loop: each step searches BM25 memory, calls an LLM through a router, and dispatches tool calls through a registry, appending every event to an audit log until the model returns a final answer.

projects.title: Book recommender
projects.description: Item-based collaborative KNN, TF-IDF content KNN, and a hybrid, trained on the UCSD Goodreads dataset of 228M user-book interactions. Polars streams 6 GB of raw files into a 50k × 770k sparse matrix in about a minute.
projects.impact: A leave-one-out evaluation on 500 users found plain collaborative KNN beats the textbook hybrid on NDCG@10 by about 46% (0.333 vs. 0.228).
projects.alt: Bar chart of NDCG@10 by recommender: collaborative KNN 0.333, 70/30 hybrid 0.271, 60/40 hybrid 0.228, content KNN 0.010.

projects.title: M6 financial forecasting
projects.description: A reproducible pipeline for the M6 competition: predict which return quintile each of 100 stocks and ETFs will land in, scored by Ranked Probability Score. Gradient-boosted classifiers on momentum and volatility features, with calibration and a conformal model for comparison.
projects.impact: The best model reaches an RPS of about 0.1565–0.1575, against 0.1600 for the naive benchmark and 0.15645 for the top published entry.
projects.alt: Animated M6 results: RPS by model against the naive benchmark, and RPS across cross-validation folds.

projects.title: Sleeper Brain
projects.tagline: Draft, lineup, and trade help for Sleeper leagues
projects.description: Syncs a user's Sleeper leagues and recommends draft picks, lineups, and trades from the nfl-data projections. Leagues refresh hourly during the season.
projects.impact: Lineups come from a PuLP solver, defense outcomes from 800-draw Monte Carlo simulations with p10/p90 ranges, and trade ideas from a mutual-gain simulation. 520 tests.
projects.alt: Sleeper Brain lineup optimizer showing projection model settings and recommended starters with floor and ceiling projections.

projects.title: CFB Sicko
projects.description: Replaced a shared spreadsheet for a weekly picks league. Lines freeze on Tuesday, each player locks five picks by Thursday night, and standings update from the same board.
projects.impact: The board and the grader read the same frozen line, so a pick can't drift from the number the league actually played.
projects.alt: CFB Sicko weekly board with each player's locked picks and live game status.

projects.title: NFL Survivor
projects.description: A private survivor pool with invite codes, picks hidden until each game's kickoff, and a live Sunday board. Survival is computed from stored results, so a refresh can't change who is alive.

projects.title: FFPy
projects.description: Open-source fantasy football toolkit: nflverse and ESPN ingestion, weekly projections, and lineup optimization with linear programming, behind Streamlit and FastAPI apps. CI builds the Docker image and deploys to Fly.

projects.title: Store Sales forecasting
projects.description: Kaggle store-sales forecasting for Ecuador: config-driven lag and rolling features, LightGBM against Nixtla statistical baselines and a zero-shot TOTO run, scored on RMSLE.
